title: Makalu - Volatility and Spread
description: Hase's Volatility (vol_bps_ema) and Spread (spread_bps_ema), and their ratio vol/spread, computed here from the two.

targets.query:
union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "Makalu")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Volatility")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.execution_size == "${execution_size}" and r.param_id == "${vol_param}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vol_bps" or r._field == "vol_bps_ema")
  ,
  from(bucket: "Makalu")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Spread")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.execution_size == "${execution_size}" and r.param_id == "${spread_param}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "spread_bps_ema")
  
])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "bps")

vol = from(bucket: "Makalu")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Volatility")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.execution_size == "${execution_size}" and r.param_id == "${vol_param}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vol_bps_ema")
spread = from(bucket: "Makalu")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Spread")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.execution_size == "${execution_size}" and r.param_id == "${spread_param}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "spread_bps_ema")
ratio = join(tables: {v: vol, s: spread}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "vol_spread_ratio", _value: r._value_v / r._value_s }))
ratio
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "ratio")

from(bucket: "Makalu")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
